spec.title: vscode-extension PROP-003: Layers - the manifest overlay, the entry module, the absences, and the rebrand set

status.comment: the type's answer to the layers question of PROP-016 §2, written 2026-11-01 from DESIGN-002 §2 and §4

overlay.title: 1. config-overlay: the manifest and the locale manifests

p.VSX-MANIFEST-OVERLAY: `<extensionRoot>/package.json` is the product manifest of this family and the first overlay target: the whole document is open to an overlay (`allowedKeys` null), nothing is stamped by the packaging, and there is no dev channel. Identity (`name`, `displayName`, `description`, `publisher`, `version`, `icon`, `galleryBanner`, `repository`, `homepage`, `bugs`, `author`, `keywords`), the host contract (`engines`, `main`, `browser`, `activationEvents`, `extensionKind`) and every contribution (`contributes`) are keys of this one file, and an overlay edits them as JSON (`spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-005#OVERLAY-OP-SHAPE`): an array of contributions is replaced whole by a `set` on its parent, with `expectUpstream` carrying the pin's array so that an upstream change of a title is `CK-E-OVERLAY-DRIFT` and not a silent overwrite. The manifest carries no npm semantics for an overlay: the extension's dependencies are installed by the family's install, never pruned through it (`spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-005#OVERLAY-NPM-DECLARED-TARGETS`).

p.VSX-NO-DEV-CHANNEL: No overlay target of this type has a dev channel: the host reads the manifest from the extension root, in the development host as in the installed product, and reads no sidecar instead. The overlay is therefore materialized into the tree whenever a host is to see it - by `package` for the distributable and by `preview` for a person - and the materialization is the one `load --fresh` recognizes as the tool's own (`spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-005#OVERLAY-KNOWN-MATERIALIZATION`, `spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-007#CMD-PREVIEW`).

p.VSX-LOCALE-MANIFEST-OVERLAYS: `<extensionRoot>/package.nls.json` and every `<extensionRoot>/package.nls.<locale>.json` the pin carries, and every file `typeConfig.localeManifests` names, are overlay targets of the same shape - open, no dev channel. They are the official localization of manifest strings: a flat object of key to string, read by the host for the locale it runs in. A product whose upstream ships none has none to target and localizes its manifest strings in the manifest itself (`VSX-MANIFEST-OVERLAY`). The type names the `package.nls*.json` targets from the configuration it is given, not from the tree: a patch set lists in `localeManifests` the locale files its pin actually carries, and the engine refuses an overlay of a file the pin does not carry as it does for any target.

p.VSX-ENTRY-MODULE: The entry modules of this type are the files `typeConfig.entryModules` names, by default `<extensionRoot>/src/extension.ts`: the module whose `activate` the host calls is where an extension composes itself, so a graft that imports own code belongs there (`spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-005#EM-PURPOSE`). A webview with its own entry adds that entry to the list. The layer itself - the two forms, the marker discipline, the `# layer: entry-module` carrier - is the engine's; the concrete entry is confirmed against the manifest's `main` at every pin by the person who writes the graft, because `main` names the bundle and not its source.

p.VSX-NO-OWN-EXTENSIONS: `ownExtensions` answers null and the capability is absent: the family has no extension host of its own (PROP-002 `VSX-NO-OWN-EXTENSION-PATH`).

p.VSX-NO-SERVICE-OVERRIDE: `serviceOverride` answers null and the capability is absent: an extension has no uniform service registry whose last registration wins and no container whose rebind the type could verify; what one extension calls a service is a module of its own, overridden by own code through the entry module or by a patch. The specimen's dependency structure is a product fact and not the family's.

rebrand.title: 4. How the rebrand toolkit maps onto the layers

p.VSX-REBRAND-SET: The first change of every product of this family is the same, and it is one generated set of interventions over the existing layers, by the layer order of `spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-005#LAYER-CHOICE-RULE`: (1) the manifest's strings and identity are a `config-overlay` of `VSX-MANIFEST-OVERLAY`, and of `VSX-LOCALE-MANIFEST-OVERLAYS` where they exist; (2) every translated or hard-coded string that passes through a translate function is branded at render time by the brand table of the own layer, grafted by one hook patch of type `hook` at each funnel of the product (PROP-005 `VSX-GEN-BRAND`, `VSX-BRAND-HOOK`); (3) the icons the manifest names and the README and CHANGELOG are `resource-file` entries, with the licence texts and the third-party notices never among the targets; (4) a string built outside every funnel - an extension identifier, a telemetry identifier, a documentation address - is a marker patch of type `hook` or an own constant the hook reads; (5) the generated leftover guard proves that nothing of the original terms survives in the bundle and the manifest outside the licence files (PROP-005 `VSX-BRAND-LEFTOVER-GUARD`). The identifier namespaces of commands and settings and the service endpoints of the product are not part of the set: both are product decisions with a compatibility cost, recorded in the product's own repository (DESIGN-002 §1.6).

p.DECISION-VSX-NO-TERM-LAYER: **Decision:** the rebrand uses the existing layers and the existing `gen brand` machinery; no term-substitution layer and no new engine of `rewrite-rule` is added for it. **Why:** a brand table hooked into the funnels brands every string of every locale at render time with one module and one hook per funnel - the shape the first type already uses for its `nls.ts` funnel (`spec://codkit/modules/vscode/PROP-008#GEN-BRAND`) - and the dictionaries of the family are code, not data, so neither an overlay nor a patch per entry is honest: the first cannot reach them, the second is the patch pile the layer metric forbids (`spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-005#LAYER-METRIC`). A new layer kind is a change of the conventions, the completeness check and every inventory consumer (`spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-005#EVERY-LAYER-IS-AN-ARTIFACT`). **Considered and rejected:** a `term-map` engine of `rewrite-rule` over locale files (hundreds of generated patches, re-counted at every upstream release, and a drift guard that would have to learn a transformed pin); per-locale overlays (hundreds of artifacts); patching the upstream's own rename codemods into the tree (the specimen's tool, not the family's). **When to revisit:** when a product needs branded strings in a place no funnel reaches and patches of dictionary files begin to accumulate - the metric of `LAYER-METRIC` is the trigger.
